message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 74.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Management and system developer. I want to become a Information Technology Auditor. My family can afford at most about USD 6700 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Management and system developer roles

explanation:
This MBA Technology Management program in Delhi is highly recommended because it offers the highest placement rate (90%) and a strong median starting salary ($17361), directly addressing your priority of securing a good job after graduation. The minimum required grade (79%) is slightly higher than your 74.8%, but its superior career outcomes make it worth considering.

Located in Mumbai, this MSc IT Management program offers a strong placement rate (88%) and a solid median starting salary ($13973). The tuition fee is manageable within your budget, making it an excellent balance of career prospects and affordability.

This MSc Information Systems program in Coimbatore provides a good blend of business information systems knowledge and strong placement metrics (85% rate, $15394 salary). The tuition is also very low ($2400), making it an attractive option that meets your interest in IT Management.

The MBA Technology Management at Crestwood University in Hyderabad is a strong contender due to its favorable tuition cost ($1900) and high median starting salary ($15400). It aligns perfectly with your interest in IT Management while remaining well within your family's budget.

This MBA Technology Management program in Hyderabad is cost-effective ($1250 tuition) and covers both IT Management and Software Engineering fields. It offers a decent median starting salary ($13142), making it a reliable choice that balances affordability with career focus.
